_: Work in the countryside's fields through the farming year (field_work.gd; docs/research/world-and-siege-rules.md rules 9-12; Manor Lords' ox ploughing and harvest, Kingdom Come's routines, Anno's busy fields). The farm state is the countryside's own: each field's crop and how far through the realm's season it is (countryside.gd _stage: green shoots in spring, gold then stubble in autumn on the field's own reaping day). on: the switch (--fieldwork=off). every: seconds between looks; reach: fields worked within this of the camera (world units); keep: and dropped past this; most_fields: fields worked at once. year: what a field is doing, the first row that fits: season, t (how far through it, [from, to)), crops (standing: wheat, barley, flax; lifted: cabbages, beans; any), stage (the crop's stage, if given), job. jobs: men ([fewest, most]), post (their mind's activities, npc_mind.gd), roles (picked in turn), sex ('f' for women only), and for plough: team (the beast), oxen, pace (world units a second), furrows (lines walked across the field); for reap and glean: stooks (how many stand in rows as the field is cut, rising with the reaping; carted off from stooks_gone through the season) and binders (who stook the sheaves, post binder). hunger: in a starving land (the nearest town's mood) fewer hands, this share. flock: a shepherd and his sheep grazing a fallow field and moving to another every move_every seconds (most flocks near the camera at once, pace, how far they spread).
